notes: Hipparcos I/239 (epoch J1991.25, ICRS). alt/az: airless apparent topocentric (no refraction, no polar motion). ra/dec: apparent topocentric, true equator & equinox of date. astrometric: geocentric ICRS unit vectors incl. proper motion and parallax. catalog_icrs: barycentric unit vectors at Julian epoch years with linear space motion (radial velocity 0).
